title: resolve_secret_uri duplicated across two main.rs files
description:
The resolve_secret_uri async helper is copy-pasted between crates/transit/src/main.rs (line 212) and crates/reader/src/main.rs, with a comment on line 210 of the transit copy acknowledging the duplication: 'NOTE: An identical copy of this function exists in crates/reader/src/main.rs. If you change the logic here, change it there too.'

This is a classic dual-maintenance footgun. The comment is the only enforcement mechanism. In a solo maintainer context, a bug fix or secretx behavior change applied to one copy will silently not apply to the other. The comment will become invisible as the file grows.

The function is not test-covered (it performs process::exit on error, making it difficult to unit-test, which is part of why it was not extracted).

Fix: move resolve_secret_uri into a shared crate (stoa-core or a new stoa-startup utility module) so there is one implementation. The process-exit behavior can be preserved by having the shared function return Result and leaving the exit call in each main.rs.
notes: Pre-existing issue, not caused by wildmat epic. Tracked separately as stoa-4c00250e.
